Class PoolLink.LineStream

java.lang.Object
java.io.InputStream
org.casserole.pool.PoolLink.LineStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
Enclosing class:
PoolLink
private static final class PoolLink.LineStream extends InputStream
The LineStream class is the inbound side of one WebSocket. accept(String) offers one frame. read() blocks until a frame, or until end().

  • Method Details

    • accept

      void accept(String text)
      The accept method offers one text frame as a line. A newline is added when the frame does not already end with one. A full queue ends the stream.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is one JSON-RPC object.

    • end

      void end()
      The end method lets a blocked read finish.

    • read

      public int read() throws IOException
      The read method returns the next byte. The method waits up to 200 milliseconds between checks so a close can finish the stream.
      Specified by:
      read in class InputStream
      Returns:
      The return value is the next byte, or -1 at the end.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the wait is interrupted.
